purpose: Repair the specific failed product/build mechanism and produce one updated executable.

execution.instructions: Repair only the concrete failure against the original goal in the existing owned app. Read app AGENTS.md and configured Genny verification guidance. When a Completed checker is a declared dependency, read its typed canonical artifact through request.evidence_files and report.json; inspect a retained screenshot only when it helps diagnose the failed UI criterion. When no artifact exists, use the actual failure supplied in the brief and inspect current source/build state; never invent proof. Preserve completed scaffold/source and unchanged passing tests. Complete only missing supported scaffold operations after an interrupted initialization, respecting overwrite guards; never reinitialize a valid project. Fix the common mechanism instead of adding case-specific exceptions. Run the smallest affected checks and one Genny build --install for .qualification/server using configured Go/shared caches. Do not change protected assertions, runtime/configuration, budgets or capability settings; do not run the independent checker, deploy, create extra source workspaces or launch agents. Return at most 250 words: complete or blocked, mechanism/files changed, reused/new check evidence, precise remaining failure, and final binary path plus full SHA256. The root owns the next fixed recheck. Do not delegate tasks; return the assigned scoped result. For local auth doctor checks, generate an ephemeral GENNY_AUTH_TOTP_SECRET_KEY if required; do not request or load live secrets. Use genny build --install --output .qualification/server for the one canonical executable.
